name: Media library
cantPlay: This file can’t be played in the browser
s.name: By name
emptyLibText: All backing tracks, parts, lessons and recordings land here — audio and video, including those added to songs. You can pick several files at once.
discAria: Record: tap to play or pause, spin to seek
armAria: Tonearm: drag to pick a position
songEmpty: This song has no audio or video yet
emptyText: A backing track, part, lesson or recording — audio or video. The file you pick will be ready next time you come back.
dragHint: Drag along the waveform to seek
delText: The file will disappear from the library and from all songs on this device.
newGoesBoth: New files go both to the song and to the shared library.
noDb: Storage is unavailable, files will be lost after reload.
libInfo: Library: {files}, {mb} MB, on this device only.
allInSong: All files are already in the song
vinylHint: Vinyl: tap the record to play or pause. Spin speed follows playback speed.
notSaved: The file won’t be kept after reload
stepHint: Mark an A–B section and speed will rise 5% with each loop
about: Audio and video, speed, loop, timecodes
markAdd: Add a mark at the current position
markLoop: Loop up to the next mark
marksInfo: Marks are stored with the file and show up in every song. Tap a mark on the timeline or in the row below it to jump there.
toSongsInfo: A tick means the song has all selected files. Tapping adds them all to the song or removes them all.
monoFixed: This style keeps the view fixed: {v}.
help.what: Recordings and videos to study and play along with.
help.1: “+” adds files; they stay on this device.
help.3: A–B loops a passage; markers jump to key spots.
help.tip: Take a hard passage at 70–80 % speed, then raise it.
key.title: Key
stems.hint: Volume of each stem — together with key and speed. Voice to zero — backing track; the rest to zero — one part. All at 100 % — the original recording plays.
key.formantHint: For a voice: the timbre stays natural. Turn off for music: a “ghost” of the original is audible
key.hint: Pitch changes, speed does not. Up to ±3 semitones is nearly transparent; voices sound a little different on larger shifts.
key.detectFail: Could not detect from this recording
stems.title: Stems and notes
stems.mode.6: Vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other — 1.5× longer; guitar and keys separate more roughly.
stems.goHint: Runs on the device, in the background. Finished stems appear here: each one's volume along with key and speed. In the library settings, separation can run by itself for every new recording.
stems.web: Stems are available only in the app (Android, Windows).
stems.webHint: The separation models take 235 MB and are not part of the web version.
stems.saved: Done: stems are in the library
stems.none: No stems found: the recording is quiet or empty
job.busy: Another job is running — wait for it to finish.
notes.bendsHint: Bends and slides — for voice, guitar, violin
notes.none: No notes found: quiet recording or no pitch
notes.hint: Notes from the recording (.mid) go to the library next to it. Best with a single instrument or voice: separate a mix first and transcribe a stem.
notes.doneHint: The .mid file is in the library next to the recording. In Tabs — as notation and tablature; in the studio — edit, change the sound and tempo.
stems.hqHint: Three passes instead of one: cleaner stem edges, 4.5× the time. The first version is kept.
